[bold #D75FFF]◆ EPIC sase-ag[/bold #D75FFF]
[dim]  Title: [bold #D7AFFF][/dim]Plan-file provenance header block[/bold #D7AFFF]
[dim]   Goal: [#D7D7AF][/dim]Every committed plan file opens with one beautiful, self-healing [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]header block whose bullets link the plan to its prompt, its parent [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]plan, every agent that worked it, and every commit it produced, [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]with GitHub URLs that render as hyperlinks on github.com.[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]   Path: [#87AFFF][/dim]plans:202607/[bold #87AFFF][/#87AFFF]plan_header_provenance.md[/bold #87AFFF]
[dim]  1 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Rust-owned plan header block grammar[/bold #D7AFFF]                          [bold black on #FFD75F] medium [/bold black on #FFD75F]
    [#AF87FF]block-contract[dim] · [dim][/dim]no dependencies[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]block-contract: replace the single-bullet SDD artifact-link contract in [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]sase-core with a multi-section, nestable, wrap-tolerant header block, [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]expose it through PyO3, and reimplement the existing Python adapter on [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]top of it without changing current behavior.[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  2 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Hosted URL resolution for plans, agents, and commits[/bold #D7AFFF]          [bold black on #87D7FF] small  [/bold black on #87D7FF]
    [#AF87FF]hosted-links[dim] · [dim][/dim]no dependencies[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]hosted-links: add one local-only module that resolves a plan reference, [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]an agent name, and a commit SHA to absolute GitHub URLs, degrading to [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]unlinked labels instead of guessing.[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  3 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Derived plan association index[/bold #D7AFFF]                                [bold black on #FFD75F] medium [/bold black on #FFD75F]
    [#AF87FF]associations[dim] · [dim][/dim]after hosted-links[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]associations: derive each plan's agents and commits from commit footers [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]and agent artifact metadata, roll descendant associations up into epic [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]plans, and return ready-to-render sections.[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  4 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Header writes at propose, commit, and post-commit[/bold #D7AFFF]             [bold black on #FFD75F] medium [/bold black on #FFD75F]
    [#AF87FF]write-points[dim] · [dim][/dim]after block-contract, hosted-links, associations[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]write-points: seed PROMPT and PARENT when a plan is proposed and [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]committed, stop stamping the parent frontmatter property, and refresh [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]the named plan's header best-effort after each primary commit.[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  5 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Tree-wide refresh and parent-property migration[/bold #D7AFFF]               [bold black on #FFD75F] medium [/bold black on #FFD75F]
    [#AF87FF]reconcile[dim] · [dim][/dim]after write-points[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]reconcile: add sase plan links refresh for bulk, idempotent header [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]reconciliation, migrate existing parent frontmatter into PARENT bullets,[/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]and deprecate the frontmatter property in the plan schema.[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  6 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Display, documentation, and validation surfaces[/bold #D7AFFF]               [bold black on #87D7FF] small  [/bold black on #87D7FF]
    [#AF87FF]surfaces[dim] · [dim][/dim]after block-contract, reconcile[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]surfaces: teach the ACE plan viewer, the plans sidecar README, and the [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]CLI help/output about the header block so the new bullets read well [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]everywhere they are shown.[/#D7D7AF]
